exposure: Maternal smoking status (before pregnancy, during pregnancy, after delivery)
outcome: Maternal smoking status during pregnancy and child-rearing
cohort: A group of 727 mothers (from an initial 1,220 respondents) in a Japanese rural area who provided data from pregnancy registration until their children's 36-month health checkup.
finding: Approximately 60% of mothers who smoked before and after delivery failed smoking cessation, with mothers under 28 years of age at pregnancy registration being significantly more likely to relapse after delivery.
